date_note: CERT-AGID's page is dated 26 November and says the campaign was detected the day before; it gives no earlier date.
title: CERT-AGID: interactive phishing campaign impersonating Agenzia delle Entrate targets CIE logins
geo_basis: country named in the CERT-AGID notice; centroid approximate
summary: CERT-AGID says it detected a phishing campaign using the name of the Agenzia delle Entrate to steal CIE credentials. The fake page, on a compromised domain, copies the CIE level 2 login. CERT-AGID describes an interactive approach, with a control panel letting operators adapt requests to victims. It says it requested the domain's takedown and shared indicators of compromise.
plain: Italy's CERT-AGID says criminals are using a fake tax-agency message and a copied CIE login page to steal digital identity credentials, adapting their requests to each victim.
exec: CERT-AGID says the campaign aims at stealing CIE credentials, which give access to online services.
action: CERT-AGID advises checking the domain of authentication pages and not sharing temporary codes or approving access requests the user did not start.

review.note: date, summary, advice against CERT-AGID notice
